en.name: Doenjang
en.summary: Doenjang is Korea's salted, fermented soybean paste — deeper, coarser and funkier than most Japanese miso. An unopened tub keeps about 12–24 months in a cool dark cupboard. Once opened, refrigerate it and reckon on about 12 months, a figure taken from miso rather than published for doenjang.
en.pantry: Unopened tubs keep to the printed date in a cool dark place, about 12–24 months from purchase. Salt and low water activity are what preserve it, which is why a sealed tub does not need cold. Traditional 된장 was kept for years in an earthenware jar outdoors at a much higher salt level; supermarket tubs are milder and less forgiving, so once the seal is broken the cupboard is no longer the right place.
en.fridge: Refrigerate after opening at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and reckon on about 12 months — that figure comes from the miso line, since no agency publishes one for doenjang. Press the surface flat and keep the plastic disc or a sheet of cling film directly on it, and use a clean dry spoon only. Darkening and a stronger, more ammoniac aroma over time are normal ageing rather than spoilage. A white bloom on the surface is usually yeast and can be stirred in or scraped off; fuzzy coloured mould means the tub goes out.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for doenjang and no real need for one: it is salty enough to last a year in the fridge, which is longer than most households take to finish a tub. It will not freeze solid at domestic freezer temperatures because of the salt, so a tub in the freezer behaves much like a tub in the fridge, only less convenient. Use the space for something perishable.
spoilage: Fuzzy or coloured mould — green, black or pink — on the surface
A rotten or solvent-like smell rather than a deep, salty, ammoniac one
The tub swelling, or gas escaping when opened
Liquid pooling with an unpleasant sour smell, as opposed to normal dark tamari-like seepage
tips: Keep the surface pressed flat and covered; air is what dries and darkens the top layer.
Use a clean dry spoon every time — never one that has been in the soup.
Write the opening date on the tub.
Buy the tub size that matches how often you make jjigae; a year passes quickly.

faq.q: Does doenjang need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Unopened, no — about 12–24 months in a cool dark cupboard. After opening, yes: refrigerate at 4 °C or below for about 12 months.

faq.q: Is the white film on top of my doenjang mould?
faq.a: Usually it is yeast, and it can be stirred in or scraped off. Fuzzy coloured mould is different and means discarding the tub.
There is no timeline and no need. The salt keeps it for about a year refrigerated, and it will not freeze solid anyway.

faq.q: Why has my doenjang gone darker?
faq.a: That is normal ageing. The colour deepens and the aroma gets stronger and more ammoniac over time without becoming unsafe.

zh.name: 韓式大醬
zh.summary: 韓式大醬是韓國的鹽漬發酵黃豆醬，比多數日式味噌更深沉、顆粒更粗、風味也更野。未開封的盒裝放在陰涼避光處大約 12～24 個月。開封後請冷藏，大約以 12 個月為準——這個數字取自味噌，不是專為大醬發表的。
zh.pantry: 未開封的盒裝放在陰涼避光處，到標示日期為止，從購買日起算大約 12～24 個月。保存它的是鹽和低水活性，所以未拆封的盒裝不需要冷藏。傳統的된장是放在戶外陶甕裡、用高得多的鹽度存放好幾年；超市的盒裝鹽度較低、容錯率也低，所以封口一開，櫥櫃就不再適合。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下冷藏，大約以 12 個月為準——這個數字來自味噌的資料，因為沒有機構為大醬公布過期限。請把表面壓平，讓附的塑膠片或保鮮膜直接貼著醬面，而且只用乾淨乾燥的湯匙。顏色隨時間變深、氣味變得更強烈甚至帶點氨味，都是正常的熟成而不是腐壞。表面的白色薄膜通常是酵母，可以拌進去或刮掉；但如果是有顏色的毛狀霉，整盒就要丟掉。
zh.freezer: 大醬沒有冷凍期限，實際上也不需要：它夠鹹，冷藏就能放大約一年，比多數家庭用完一盒的時間還長。而且因為鹽分高，它在家用冷凍庫也不會真的凍硬，放冷凍其實和放冷藏差不多，只是更不方便。冷凍空間留給易腐食材比較好。
spoilage: 表面出現毛狀或有顏色的霉——綠色、黑色或粉紅色
聞起來是腐敗味或溶劑味，而不是深沉的鹹香帶氨味
盒子膨脹，或開蓋時有氣體跑出
積出的液體帶不舒服的酸敗味（正常滲出的深色醬汁則沒問題）
tips: 醬面壓平並貼緊覆蓋；讓表層乾掉發黑的是空氣。
每次都用乾淨乾燥的湯匙——絕對不要用剛攪過湯的那支。
依照做鍋物的頻率選盒子大小；一年過得很快。

faq.a: 未開封不用，陰涼避光處大約 12～24 個月。開封後要，放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 12 個月。

faq.q: 大醬上面的白膜是霉嗎？
faq.a: 通常是酵母，拌進去或刮掉都可以。有顏色的毛狀霉則不同，整盒要丟。
沒有對應期限，也沒有必要。鹽讓它冷藏就能放大約一年，而且它本來也凍不硬。

faq.q: 大醬顏色變深了正常嗎？
faq.a: 正常，那是熟成。顏色會加深、香氣會更強烈甚至帶氨味，但並不代表不安全。
